brief.t: START HERE: Call Aaron and Evelyn, with Sam looped in, to reconcile both Silk Factor lots and actual shipments before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 1: Silk Factor disposition and shipment traceability. November 13 discrepancy is 10 days old. Luke's client signature is verified; microbial results, dates, batch records and lot-specific shipment traceability remain unresolved. Send internally: Aaron, Evelyn and Ron, reconcile both lots, shipments, microbial results and batch records against Luke's signed waiver with Sam today, then document authorized disposition before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 2: Morning Glory cooling safety. Evelyn's November 17 above-recommended-use concern is 6 days old; no verified controlled-formula safety disposition. Send internally: Ron, Aaron and Evelyn, reconcile the controlled formula and supplier safe-use documentation with Sam today, then record approved limits before another sample, increase or lot change.

ACT NOW 3: Hunter audit readiness tomorrow. Audit Tuesday November 24, one day away; first status due November 20 at 4 PM is 3 calendar days past, completion unverified. Installation starts today, not proof of commissioned or validated machinery. Send internally: Ron and Evelyn, confirm master-1138 status and missing evidence today; I'll provide my document and resource status, resolve November 25 dates transparently, and keep commissioning, cleaning verification, training and release gated.
